changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwpatientrelation AS SELECT pr.id, pr.patient_id, pr.relative_patient_id, pr.relation_type, pr.category_type, pr.created_by, pr.created_date, pr.last_modified_by, pr.last_modified_date FROM public.patient_relation pr;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwpatientrelation TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwpatientrelation FROM report_user;
